ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels; macro-ratio of white to black is approximately 1:20, with high-intensity pixels localized to anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous solid dark pigmentation across the visible field; no distinct geometric mottling or macro-scale color variations detected on the fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 45-50 degrees dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetric irregular boundary; left lobe medial edge displays 4-6 prominent jagged peaks; right lobe displays lower-amplitude, higher-frequency serrations toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex posterior curvature tapering to sharply acute, upward-oriented lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast white/tan pixel rosettes localized on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; two isolated circular spots on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct parallel linear pixel disruptions of light-grey intensity on the mid-section of the left lobe, oriented diagonally toward the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of high-contrast calcified organisms (barnacles) on the trailing edge and distal tips of both lobes.
